CFML Language Reference: Functions

DaysInMonth

Returns 28, 29, 30 or 31: the length of the month in which the given date falls.

Category

Date and time functions

Syntax

DaysInMonth(date)

Parameters

date
A date/time value or a string that can be converted to one. Only its year and month matter.

Returns

The number of days in that month.

Usage

The argument is a date, not a month number; to ask about February 2000, pass any date in it, such as CreateDate(2000, 2, 1). Leap years are handled correctly, including the century rule.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Month</TH><TH>Days</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="Y" LIST="1900,1999,2000">
<TR><TD>February #Y#</TD><TD>#DaysInMonth(CreateDate(Y, 2, 1))#</TD></TR>
</CFLOOP>
<CFLOOP INDEX="M" FROM="9" TO="12">
<TR><TD>#MonthAsString(M)# 1999</TD><TD>#DaysInMonth(CreateDate(1999, M, 1))#</TD></TR>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>
